correctness.rationale: Using published Theorem 14 as a stated premise, the recurrence companion matrix is unimodular with M^10=I+4B and backward s_-6=s_-1=0. Exact first-order coefficients eBM^-6v=1 and eBM^-1v=9 are odd. For each r>0, ((I+4B)^r-I)/(4r) is congruent to B modulo two because v2(4^(j-1)/j)>=1 for j>=2. This proves s_(10r-6)=4r*odd and s_(10r-1)=4r*odd, giving the claimed unbounded exact valuations; the multiplicative 1-run transform adds valuations across repeated runs including n=0. I recomputed matrix and 200 progression valuations independently, not an infinite empirical generalization.
